goal: Lets users pin outgoing connections to a specific local source address on multi-homed hosts
Closes a long-open request (#6476) since the OS routing table otherwise picks the source address
reviewability: Ready to review: no open substantive request remains, only a nonblocking naming aside
Author actively pushed fixes through 2026-08-19 addressing all prior review comments
agreement: Strong support after author redesigned the feature into a standalone option to resolve design objections (gmaxwell, luke-jr)
Concept ACK with review comments, later addressed (frankomosh)
Approach ACK with only a nonblocking naming preference (winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is a long-requested but narrow, opt-in convenience feature for multi-homed hosts
Benefits users who need control over outbound source address, not consensus- or DoS-relevant work
No security, stability, or performance dimension so it is worthwhile but deferrable
